name: lapce
description_en: Lightning-fast and Powerful Code Editor written in Rust
readme_excerpt: Lapce Lightning-fast And Powerful Code Editor Lapce (IPA: /læps/) is written in pure Rust, with a UI in Floem. It is designed with Rope Science from the Xi-Editor, enabling lightning-fast computation, and leverages wgpu for rendering. More information about the features of Lapce can be found on the main website and user documentation can be found on GitBook.
